images.name: light
images.prompt:
Ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic game background, 2000 x 667, stylized painterly softly faceted 3D game art. Reference 1 is ONLY lumberjack farm art direction, red barn, autumn maples, pine trees, logs, hay and farm props. Reference 2 Kyoto veranda is the exact camera, framing, depth and composition reference.
Seated eye-level viewer under a rustic timber lumberyard porch, horizon 48% up from bottom. Cylindrical wide panoramic feel, no fisheye top/bottom bulge. Wooden ceiling rafters and foreground floorboards strongly lead toward central vanishing point, gently curving like Kyoto. Two heavy wooden posts frame the broad central opening, low timber rails at deck edge on both sides with a big central gap. Porch wraps down left and right as long covered workshop wings, replacing Kyoto shoji corridors with lumber storage and farm work areas.
At least 10-15 metres away beyond porch, a modest distant RED BARN perfectly centred across open farm courtyard, small in frame like Kyoto's distant garden gate, not filling image. Cream X-braced doors, central open mail hatch with a few cream envelopes and amber lamp above, hatch just below horizon. Soft hills and pines behind barn, warm autumn landscape.
Furnish lateral sides and middle distance richly: stacked cut logs in covered racks, split firewood, chopping blocks, sawhorses, woodworker benches with gloves and hand tools, rope coils, barrels, crates, hay bales, wheelbarrow, rustic wagon and fence. Place two autumn orange maple trees flanking yard behind side furnishings. Different coherent groupings left and right, orderly inhabited lumberyard rather than symmetrical duplicated clutter. Keep clutter on lateral edges and midground, preserve calm central barn and a broad open lane from viewer to hatch.
CRITICAL foreground: bare clean honey-brown porch floor, no table, desk or bench across front of player, no props in near centre. Viewer has open air ahead. Side workbenches only at extreme margins. No people, weapon in hand, text, lettering, UI or vignette.
LIGHT version: golden afternoon daylight, soft pale blue sky, warm autumn foliage, inviting red barn, small amber lantern accents beneath shaded porch. Full-bleed single panorama.

images.name: dark
images.prompt: Use this exact panorama as edit base. Make DARK/night version changing ONLY illumination and sky color. Preserve exact camera, 3:1 framing, architecture, every beam, pillar, floorboard, railing, tree, branch, cloud, distant central barn, all side benches, tools, hay, wood stacks, carts and props in identical positions. Replace afternoon light with deep twilight/night indigo and muted purple sky, soft cool moonlight from offscreen across open yard, autumn trees and porch edges. Existing amber porch lanterns and small barn hatch lamp cast warm pools on timber and gentle floor reflections; barn upper window glows softly amber, central mail hatch warmly readable. Dark blue and plum shadows beneath porch and in forest, cozy slightly mysterious lumberyard after hours, maintain readable side equipment. Central barn remains small distant focal point and foreground stays empty. No added objects, moon, stars, people, particles, writing, UI or vignette. Same painterly stylized 3D game art, 2000x667 panoramic.
